# Load libraries

```{r load_libraries}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(purrr)
```

# Load and prepare data

Features come from the MATLAB pipeline (one row per image). Sample information comes from a separate metadata file, so group and time point never depend on file names or file order.

`sample_metadata.csv` is not in the repository. Create it from `sample_metadata_template.csv` with one row per image and **anonymised donor codes** (D1, D2, ...).

```{r load_and_preprocess_data}
FEATURES_FILE <- "allImagesFeatures_.xlsx"
METADATA_FILE <- "sample_metadata.csv"

PIXEL_TO_UM <- 0.252525
PIXEL_TO_UM2 <- PIXEL_TO_UM^2

FEATURES_TO_UM <- c(
  "aveg_meanDiam", "std_meanDiam", "max_maxDiam", "aveg_maxDiam",
  "std_maxDiam", "aveg_stdDiam", "std_stdDiam", "avg_diamWholeCulture",
  "std_diamWholeCulture", "medianSkelLength", "meanSkelLength",
  "stdSkelLength", "maxSkelLength"
)
FEATURES_TO_UM2 <- c("meanRatioAreaLength", "areaImage")
UNITLESS <- c("percMyoArea", "nFibres", "meanBranches", "totalBranches", "fusionIndex",
              "nNucleiClusters", "meanNucleiPerCluster", "meanMyoIntensity")

features_raw <- if (grepl("\\.csv$", FEATURES_FILE)) read.csv(FEATURES_FILE) else read_excel(FEATURES_FILE)
metadata <- read.csv(METADATA_FILE)

# Every image must have exactly one metadata row.
missing <- setdiff(features_raw$fileName, metadata$fileName)
if (length(missing) > 0) stop("Images without metadata: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))

features <- features_raw %>%
  inner_join(metadata, by = "fileName") %>%
  mutate(
    across(any_of(FEATURES_TO_UM), ~ . * PIXEL_TO_UM, .names = "{.col}_um"),
    across(any_of(FEATURES_TO_UM2), ~ . * PIXEL_TO_UM2, .names = "{.col}_um2"),
    group = factor(group, levels = c("WT", "Dystrophy")),
    time = factor(time, levels = c("D2", "D6")),
    donor = factor(donor)
  ) %>%
  select(fileName, donor, group, time, ends_with("_um"), ends_with("_um2"), any_of(UNITLESS))

feature_names <- names(features)[sapply(features, is.numeric)]

# How many images and donors there are in each group: the donor is the experimental unit.
features %>%
  group_by(group, time) %>%
  summarise(images = n(), donors = n_distinct(donor), .groups = "drop") %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Images and donors per group and time point")
```

# Image-level description

Medians across images, per group and time point. Images from the same donor are not independent, so no p-values are computed at this level.

```{r image_level_summary}
image_summary <- features %>%
  group_by(group, time) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(feature_names), \(x) median(x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(feature_names), names_to = "feature", values_to = "median") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = median, names_prefix = "median_") %>%
  mutate(percent_change = 100 * (median_Dystrophy - median_WT) / median_WT)

knitr::kable(image_summary, digits = 2)
```

# Donor-level comparison

Each donor is summarised by the median of its images at each time point, and groups are compared with a Wilcoxon rank-sum test on these donor values. P-values are adjusted for the number of features tested (Benjamini-Hochberg).

With very few donors per group, these tests have little power: with 2 donors in one group, the smallest attainable p-value is well above 0.05. The results are therefore **exploratory** and should be confirmed with more donors.

```{r donor_level_tests}
donor_values <- features %>%
  group_by(donor, group, time) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(feature_names), \(x) median(x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")

donor_tests <- donor_values %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(feature_names), names_to = "feature", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(time, feature) %>%
  summarise(
    n_WT = sum(group == "WT" & !is.na(value)),
    n_Dystrophy = sum(group == "Dystrophy" & !is.na(value)),
    p_value = tryCatch(wilcox.test(value ~ group, exact = TRUE)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(time) %>%
  mutate(p_adjusted = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(time, p_value)

knitr::kable(donor_tests, digits = 3)

dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)
write_xlsx(list(image_level = image_summary, donor_level = donor_tests), "results/feature_summary_statistics.xlsx")
```

# Figures

Each point is one image, coloured by donor; diamonds are donor medians. Showing the donor structure makes clear how many independent samples support each comparison.

```{r figure_morphometry, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 9}
plot_features <- intersect(
  c("max_maxDiam_um", "avg_diamWholeCulture_um", "meanSkelLength_um", "percMyoArea", "nFibres", "meanBranches"),
  feature_names
)

plot_morphometry <- function(features_to_plot, title) {
  images_long <- features %>%
    select(donor, group, time, all_of(features_to_plot)) %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(features_to_plot), names_to = "feature", values_to = "value")
  donors_long <- donor_values %>%
    select(donor, group, time, all_of(features_to_plot)) %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(features_to_plot), names_to = "feature", values_to = "value")

  ggplot(images_long, aes(group, value)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5, fill = "grey95") +
    geom_jitter(aes(colour = donor), width = 0.12, alpha = 0.6, size = 1.8) +
    geom_point(data = donors_long, aes(fill = donor), shape = 23, size = 3.5, colour = "black") +
    facet_grid(feature ~ time, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL, colour = "Donor", fill = "Donor") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0), legend.position = "bottom")
}

p_main <- plot_morphometry(plot_features, "Myotube morphometry: WT vs dystrophy")
print(p_main)
ggsave("results/Figure4A_Morphometric_Analysis.png", p_main, width = 11, height = 12, dpi = 300)
```

```{r figure_nuclei_fusion, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 7}
nuclear_features <- intersect(c("fusionIndex", "nNucleiClusters", "meanNucleiPerCluster"), feature_names)
if (length(nuclear_features) > 0) {
  p_nuclear <- plot_morphometry(nuclear_features, "Nuclear clustering and fusion index")
  print(p_nuclear)
  ggsave("results/Figure4B_Nuclear_Fusion_Metrics.png", p_nuclear, width = 9, height = 8, dpi = 300)
}
```
